verdict.rationale: Docs confirm automated, no-code invoice creation and delivery with customizable content/branding (stripe-billing-docs-8, -26) plus quotes/estimates (-27), supporting core automated invoicing. However the evidence pack never mentions credit notes, sequential invoice numbering, or memo fields explicitly, and one community report claims Stripe lacks the 'easy... email invoicing' that a competitor (Recurly) offers (stripe-billing-comm-6), suggesting gaps in the full compliance feature set. missing for 10: explicit credit-note generation, sequential numbering guarantees, memo/custom-field support, and independent corroboration of automatic receipt delivery.
